envelope.description: Extract shared webview CSP+nonce shell into panels/shell.ts

body.title: Extract shared webview CSP+nonce shell into panels/shell.ts
body.summary: Extract the shared CSP+nonce shell (shellHtml) from panels/webview-host.ts:635 into a new panels/shell.ts so the chat panel and both scratch viewTypes share the identical shell; webview-host re-exports/uses it; existing CSP/nonce tests keep passing.
acceptanceChecks: panels/shell.ts exports the shared CSP+nonce shellHtml extracted verbatim from panels/webview-host.ts:635
webview-host.ts re-uses the extraction; all existing CSP/nonce tests keep passing unchanged (panels/__tests__/webview-host.test.ts, chat-shell.test.ts)
chat panel and both scratch viewTypes consume the identical shell from panels/shell.ts

tests.name: webview-host.test.ts + chat-shell.test.ts: existing CSP/nonce tests preserved when the shell is extracted to panels/shell.ts (shell output byte-identical, all existing assertions pass unmodified)
